section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Humor Production', presents descriptive statistics for six humor production tasks. It notes that average funniness evaluations were low and that correlations between tasks were positive, ranging up to .29. A total score for humor production ability was computed as the average of the six tasks for a sample of N=151. This humor production ability was found to be independent of age (r = -.11) and did not differ between sexes.

SAMPLE SIZE.evidence_source: Note. INC = incongruity-resolution humor; NON = nonsense humor; SEX = sexual humor. Given N = 151, p < .05 for r > .15, and p < .01 for r > .20.

_metadata_caption: Table 1 presents the descriptive statistics for the six humor production tasks. Average funniness evaluations were close to 1 suggesting rather low rated funniness in general. Correlations between tasks were all positive and ranged from nonsignificant coefficients up to .29. Because correlations between tasks of the same humor appreciation category (i.e., INC, NON, and SEX) were not necessarily higher than between categories, it did not seem appropriate to compute separate category-specific humor production scores.
